findings.evidence: "The finance office reviews self-checkout usage at the end of each quarter. Branch-level totals roll up into the consortium's shared reporting dashboard."
findings.fix: Remove this paragraph, or if self-checkout usage is meant to be evidence, explain how it relates to the fine-elimination recommendation.

findings.evidence: "the stronger choice is a systemwide end to overdue fines across all ten consortium branches"
findings.fix: Either limit the recommendation to branches comparable to the pilot sites, or state what evidence supports assuming the non-pilot branches will behave the same way.
findings.violation: The pilot covered only 5 of the 10 branches, so extending the conclusion to all ten branches without evidence that the other five branches resemble the pilot branches is an unsupported generalization.
